scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fleet/api && npm run build --workspace @fleet/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace @fleet/api" "npm run dev --workspace @fleet/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @fleet/api && npm run lint --workspace @fleet/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @fleet/api && npm run test --workspace @fleet/web
